title: LinTO Studio - Open Source AI for Transcription, Live Subtitling, and Summarization
meta_description: LinTO Studio is an open-source AI platform for transcription, live subtitling, and summarization. Built for privacy, ready for production, and self-hostable.
title_pricing: Pricing - LinTO Studio: Free, Premium €19/month, Business €15/seat
meta_description_pricing: LinTO Studio pricing: a free plan, Premium at €19 per month for individuals, Business at €15 per seat per month for teams. Live transcription with prepaid packs from €25. Open-source, hosted in France.
title_live: Live subtitles and translation for events - LinTO Live
meta_description_live: Real-time transcription and translation for conferences, assemblies and plenary sessions. SRT/RTMP feeds, QR code page for attendees, subtitle banner for screens, Teams bots. Managed per event or run by your team.

door_cloud_li2: Premium €19/month for one person, Business €15/seat/month for teams

door_live_title: Live subtitles and translation for your events
door_live_desc: Conferences, assemblies, plenary sessions, hybrid events. Speech is transcribed and translated in real time, shown on the room screen and on every attendee's phone through a QR code.
door_live_li1: SRT / RTMP feeds straight from your AV control room
door_live_li2: Up to 140 languages transcribed, simultaneous translation
door_live_li3: Public page with QR code, subtitle banner for screens
door_live_li4: Run by our team, or by yours from your LinTO Studio page

all_in_one: From recording to result in minutes
all_in_one_desc: Drop a file, invite the bot, or plug in the room. LinTO does the typing, the naming and the summarizing.
cases_title: Used by public institutions and large organizations
cases_desc: From a departmental assembly to the European Commission, LinTO runs where accuracy, languages and data sovereignty are not optional.
case_ec_title: The Commission's solution for transcription, translation and summaries
case_ec_desc: Co-developed with the European Commission, Microsoft Teams integration included, and deployed for its meetings. Dedicated models, strong security levels, and self-hosted AI models so that sensitive data never leaves the Commission.
case_ep_title: Sessions accessible in real time, on site and remotely
case_ep_desc: Live transcription and translation for participants in the room and online, with automatic summaries generated by a sovereign LLM, hosted in France.
case_wm_desc: LinTO was the live transcription and translation solution of Wikimania 2026 at the Cité des sciences: every session subtitled in real time, on screen and on attendees' phones.
case_wm_desc_long: Wikimania 2026 gathered the Wikimedia movement at the Cité des sciences in Paris from 21 to 25 July. LinTO was the live transcription and translation solution: eight rooms in parallel, each subtitled in five languages, all week, with an operator from LINAGORA on site.
case_cd35_desc: The Département d'Ille-et-Vilaine transcribes its meetings, committees and assembly sessions with LinTO and gets structured minutes out of them.
case_edf_desc: LinTO Studio runs on EDF's internal Kubernetes platform. Transcription, summaries and editing, with no data leaving the company.
case_you_title: Cloud, on-premise or fully managed for one event
case_you_desc: Tell us about your meetings, your languages and your constraints. We will point you to the right setup, and it may well be the free plan.

plan_premium_for: For one person who transcribes every week.
plan_premium_li2: Meeting bots and browser live transcription
plan_business_for: For teams. Invite members, share a workspace.
plan_business_li1: Everything in Premium, for every seat
plan_business_li2: Invite your team, readers are free

os_title: Your data stays where you decide
os_desc: LinTO Studio is released under the AGPL-3.0 license. The cloud is hosted in France. The same stack installs on your servers with Helm charts or Docker Compose, GPU included.
faq_home_a1: Yes. The Free plan gives you one hour of transcription per week, five AI summaries, twenty chat messages and a one-time live credit, with the full editor. No credit card. The code itself is free software, so you can also host it yourself.
faq_home_a2: LinTO Studio Cloud is hosted in France by LINAGORA. Your files and transcripts are not used to train models and are not shared with third parties. For stricter needs, the same platform runs on your own infrastructure.
faq_home_a3: File transcription covers more than 90 languages. Live transcription supports up to 140 languages depending on the engine, with simultaneous translation into several languages at once.
faq_home_q4: Can LinTO join my Teams meetings?
faq_home_a4: Yes. A LinTO bot joins Microsoft Teams, Jitsi, BigBlueButton and Visio (La Suite numérique) meetings, transcribes them live with speaker names, and the transcript lands in your workspace. Google Meet and Zoom are not supported yet.
faq_home_q5: I organize a conference. What do I need?
faq_home_a5: An audio feed per room from your AV control room (SRT or RTMP), and a screen or a QR code for attendees. We handle the rest, or we set your team up to run it. See the live events page and request a quote.
pricing_h1: Simple pricing. Start free, pay when it pays off.
pricing_sub: One product, one price per person. No per-minute billing on your files. Live transcription is prepaid by the minute, only when you use it. Prices excluding VAT.
pf_all_editor: Speaker detection and voice signatures, aligned collaborative editor, subtitles, exports with your own templates, sharing, search
plan_business_note_year: billed €144 per seat per year, from 2 seats
pf_business_all: Everything in Premium, per seat, pooled across the team*
pf_business_all_small: a seat is a member who can upload; readers are free
pf_api_20000: 20,000 API calls per seat per month
pricing_footnote: * Unlimited within fair use, as described in our terms of service. Nothing is ever charged automatically on files, summaries or chat. Talk to us if your usage is unusual.
packs_title: Live is prepaid, by the minute
packs_desc: Browser microphone and meeting bots (Teams, Jitsi, BigBlueButton, Visio (La Suite numérique)) consume live minutes. Buy a pack once, use it over 12 months. Premium and Business only.
packs_footnote: One minute of live transcription costs one language-minute. Each live translation adds one language-minute per minute: a meeting transcribed in French and translated into English uses 2 language-minutes per minute. Packs expire 12 months after purchase and are used oldest first.
cmp_diarization: Speaker detection and voice signatures (speaker recognition)
cmp_editor: Aligned collaborative editor, subtitles (SRT, VTT), exports (DOCX, PDF, TXT, JSON), your own document templates
cmp_bots: Meeting bots: Teams, Jitsi, BigBlueButton, Visio (La Suite numérique)
cmp_card_invoice: Card, or invoice for public sector
cmp_vat_text: Added at checkout according to your country. EU businesses with a valid VAT number pay excluding VAT.
cmp_cancel_text: Anytime from your billing portal, effective at the end of the period.
public_desc: Purchase order and invoice instead of a card, dedicated hosting, on-premise installation, or a live setup for your conference: we quote it.
faq_p_a1: You are never billed per minute on your files, summaries or chat. Paid plans are unlimited within a fair-use policy, written in our terms of service, that protects the service against abuse. In practice nobody hits it with normal work. If you ever do, the feature pauses until next month and we talk.
faq_p_a2: The unit for live transcription. One minute of live speech transcribed in its original language costs 1. Each live translation you switch on adds 1 per minute. A one-hour meeting transcribed and translated into two languages uses 180 language-minutes, that is 3 hours from your pack.
faq_p_q3: What counts as a seat in Business?
faq_p_a3: A seat is a member who can upload media or start a live transcription. Members who only read, comment or search are free. Usage is pooled across the team, however it is split between people.
faq_p_q4: Can I switch between monthly and yearly, or from Premium to Business?
faq_p_a4: Yes, from your organization's billing page. Changing plan is prorated. Changing period or cancelling is done in the billing portal and takes effect at the end of the current period.
faq_p_q5: What happens to my live minutes if I cancel?
faq_p_a5: Live packs are independent from the subscription. Minutes you bought stay valid 12 months after purchase, but using them requires an active Premium or Business plan.
faq_p_q6: I am a public body and cannot pay by card.
faq_p_a6: Contact us. LINAGORA issues an invoice on purchase order and activates your plan and live credits manually. Chorus Pro is fine.
faq_p_q7: Is the events mode included in Business?
faq_p_a7: No. Business covers your team's files, meeting bots and browser live transcription. Multi-room sessions fed by SRT or RTMP streams, scheduling and public subtitle pages for an audience are part of the live offer, quoted per event or per year. See the live events page.

live_how_desc: Three pieces. Your audio, our engine, your audience.
live_step1_desc: One SRT or RTMP stream per room from your AV control room, a microphone in a browser, or a bot that joins your Microsoft Teams, Jitsi or BigBlueButton meeting. Hybrid events mix all three.
live_step2_desc: Each room gets its own channel with its language settings. Speech is transcribed in up to 140 languages and translated into as many target languages as you need, sentence by sentence, without flicker.
live_step3_desc: A public page per session, reached by QR code or link, where each attendee picks their language, subtitles or full transcript, and the font size. A two-line subtitle banner for the room screen. Full transcripts, summaries and subtitle files after the event.
lf_qr_desc: Public or password-protected page per session. Attendees scan a QR code, choose their language and read. Nothing to install.
lf_screen_desc: A paced two-line banner made for the room screen or the video feed: readable speed, no rewriting under the reader's eyes. Also embeddable in your own web page.
lf_lang_desc: Several target languages per room at once. Attendees switch language on their own device. Used with 5 languages across 8 rooms at Wikimania 2026.
lf_av_desc: SRT and RTMP ingest, one channel per room, sessions scheduled in advance with automatic start and stop. Multi-room, multi-day.
lf_bots_desc: A LinTO bot joins Microsoft Teams, Jitsi, BigBlueButton or Visio (La Suite numérique), transcribes with the participants' names and feeds the same public page.
lf_host_title: Hosted in France, or on your site
lf_host_desc: Our cloud, GPU included, or a deployment inside your infrastructure for sensitive sessions. Open-source stack in both cases.

lo_managed_li2: Sessions, channels and languages configured for you
lo_managed_li3: QR codes and screen layouts ready before doors open

faq_l_q1: What is the delay between speech and subtitles?
faq_l_a1: A few seconds. Text appears as the sentence is spoken and is finalized when it ends. Translations follow the finalized sentence, a few seconds later.
faq_l_q2: What does my AV provider need to send you?
faq_l_a2: One audio stream per room, SRT or RTMP, from the mixing desk or the video encoder. We give them the destination address and a stream id per room, and we test it together before the event. No hardware to rent.
faq_l_q3: Can attendees use it without an app?
faq_l_a3: Yes. The public page opens in any phone browser from a QR code or a link. It can be public, password-protected, or reserved to members of your organization.
faq_l_a4: It gives rooms without interpretation a written translation, and it gives every room an accessible transcript. Wikimania 2026 used both: human interpreters in some rooms, LinTO subtitles in all of them.
faq_l_q5: Can it run inside our own network?
faq_l_a5: Yes. The full stack, GPU models included, deploys on your Kubernetes or Docker infrastructure. Sensitive sessions never leave your site.
faq_l_q6: What do we keep after the event?
faq_l_a6: Every session becomes a transcript in your LinTO Studio workspace: editable, with speakers, exportable as DOCX, PDF, SRT or VTT, and summarized on request.

title_templates: Document templates for minutes and summaries - LinTO Studio guide
meta_description_templates: How to export LinTO Studio minutes and summaries in your own Word template: placeholders, upload, preview, DOCX and PDF export, API.
tpl_h1: Your own document templates for minutes and summaries
tpl_intro: LinTO Studio turns a transcript into minutes, a summary or a verbatim, then exports it. Out of the box you get DOCX, PDF, TXT and JSON. With a template, the export comes out in your own Word layout: logo, headings, fonts, footer. It takes about ten minutes to set up, and it works on every plan.
tpl_s1: 1. Start from a Word document you already use
tpl_s1_p: Take the file your team already fills by hand: the minutes template, the letterhead, the report skeleton. Keep its styles, header and footer. The template has to be a DOCX file under 10 MB.
tpl_s2_p: Write {{output}} where the AI text should land. It is the only required field. The generated content keeps its structure (headings, lists, paragraphs) and takes the styles of your document. A minimal template looks like this:
tpl_s2_p2: Other placeholders such as {{title}}, {{date}} or {{participants}} are optional. They are shown as a short form at export time so you can fill them in. On managed and on-premise deployments they can also be extracted from the transcript by the AI: ask us to configure an extraction prompt for your service.
tpl_s3_p: Open a transcript, generate a summary or minutes from the AI services menu, then click Publication and Upload a template. Give it a name and choose who sees it: only you, or your whole organization. On Business, a template uploaded for the organization is available to every member.
tpl_s4_p: Select the template and click Preview to check the result on the current document. Then export as DOCX to keep editing in Word, or as PDF for a final version. PDF is rendered server-side with LibreOffice, so stick to common fonts or embed them in the DOCX.
tpl_tip1: Make one template per document type: minutes, executive summary, verbatim. Each AI service can be linked to its own templates.
tpl_tip2: Keep tables and columns simple. The web preview does not render page breaks, text boxes or multi-column layouts; the PDF does.
tpl_tip3: A placeholder must stay in one run of text in Word. If Word splits {{output}} across formatting changes, retype it in one go.
tpl_tip4: Templates live with your organization. Rename, replace or delete them from the same Publication panel.
tpl_api_p: Everything above is available through the API with an API token: list templates, read their placeholders, export a document with a given template in DOCX, PDF or HTML. The document engine is the open-source LinTO LLM Gateway; its document templates guide covers extraction prompts and the export endpoints.
tpl_callout: Need a template designed to your charter, or extraction of specific fields (decisions, action items, deadlines)?
